title: Episode Title: United and American Play Chicken Over Routes, Air Canada's Fancy New Jet Flops, and Frontier Guts Its Elites
summary: United and American both dropped their summer route announcements this week, and things got a little spicy when United's CEO predicted American will eventually get run out of Chicago entirely. Plus, Air Canada's brand-new A321XLR couldn't hack its highest-profile route, Frontier takes another swing at its loyalty program, and Etihad has some explaining to do after a mid-air medical emergency.
